wire.errors.sdk_startup.attach_hosting_u.tone: diagnostic with remedy; preserve the existing exception text
wire.errors.sdk_startup.attach_hosting_u.note: `message` is the refusal template; the first placeholder is an already-quoted identifier and the second carries the reason. That cause text is not always opaque: when it is the product's own not-configured hosting error (its exact type and published sentence), the caller substitutes the separately localized cause sentence, so this frame must never contain English cause wording of its own. Any other producer's reason stays opaque and verbatim, including whitespace, quotes, percent signs, brackets and non-ASCII text; neither placeholder is ever an ICU pattern or a message id. Keep the config file name and the two function names literally. The frame renders in the resolved locale, never an English pin, and locales that do not carry this namespace fall back per-namespace to English (RFC §6).
